raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-UK-PadeswoodCCUS",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Integration and operation of first-of-a-kind (FOAK) carbon capture technology at an operational cement plant may encounter unforeseen technical failure or underperformance.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Perform independent technical assurance through WSP and ensure adherence to standardized CCS Network Code operational specifications.",
      "evidence": "first at-scale UK cement plant incorporating Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) technology"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Alignment delays with spurline infrastructure construction could delay project Final Investment Decision and push back Commercial Operation Date by up to 5 months.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Synchronize development timelines across capture and spurline teams and establish Cluster Sponsor Function oversight of cluster construction schedules.",
      "evidence": "align with their spurline timelines, resulting in a subsequent 5-month delay to COD"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Cross-chain operational dependencies between the Padeswood capture plant and the Liverpool Bay transport and storage network create delivery and integration risks.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish Cluster Sponsor Function oversight to manage government-owned cross-chain delivery and operating model integration risks.",
      "evidence": "Managing government-owned cross-chain delivery risks and operating model integration risks."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Failure to meet performance thresholds for CO2 capture volume could trigger contractual under-delivery penalties and reduce ongoing revenue support.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate performance thresholds and under-delivery safeguards into the ICC Contract with active performance monitoring by the Low Carbon Contracts Company.",
      "evidence": "performance thresholds, safeguards against under-delivery, and contractual clauses covering change in law"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Financial risk under the Revenue Support Agreement from higher operational costs or unexpected lower carbon capture volumes.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Structure revenue support under the Industrial Carbon Capture Contract with payments tied directly to performance and captured CO2 volumes.",
      "evidence": "5.4.1 Revenue Support Agreement (RSA)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Discontinuation of the Padeswood project pre- or post-FID leading to loss of capital investment and failure to demonstrate cement sector CCUS.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Implement Government Support Package provisions, enforce clear conditions precedent, and maintain oversight through the Cluster Sponsor Function.",
      "evidence": "5.4.2 Discontinuation risk for Padeswood"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Exchequer funding liabilities arising from Secretary of State Direct Agreements exceeding initially allocated support thresholds.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Cap overall support within the £21.7bn Final Funding Envelope and subject agreements to strict central government financial governance.",
      "evidence": "5.4.3 Exchequer funding Secretary of State direct agreements (SoSDA)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Risk of fraud or misuse of public spending through capital grants or ongoing operational business model support payments.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Administer grant payments through DESNZ Central Grants & Loans team using Open Book Model financial reporting and ongoing compliance auditing.",
      "evidence": "5.4.4 Fraud"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Financial sensitivity to energy price volatility, macroeconomic inflation, and capital cost overruns impacting project economic viability.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deploy joint Open Book Models updated with DESNZ cost assessment templates and perform independent financial assurance through EY.",
      "evidence": "5.4.5 Financial sensitivities"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Cross-cutting and cross-chain financial and operational risks across the HyNet cluster impacting Padeswood's economics.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Proactively manage cluster-wide risks via the DESNZ Cluster Sponsor Function and align contractual terms across connected network users.",
      "evidence": "5.4.6 Cross-chain and cross-cutting risks"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Unabated cement operations subject to rising carbon prices leading companies to shift production overseas (carbon leakage).",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Deploy CCUS at Padeswood using CIF capital grants and ICC Contract revenue support to sustain domestic cement sector competitiveness.",
      "evidence": "Without investment in CCUS, companies may de-prioritise their UK interests and shift production elsewhere"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Governance fragmentation across multiple regulatory and administrative bodies (Ofgem, LCCC, DESNZ CGL, Cluster Sponsor Function) causing decision bottlenecks.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement the Post-FID Operating Model with clear functional division between LCCC, DESNZ CGL, Ofgem, and central coordination by the Cluster Sponsor Function.",
      "evidence": "Padeswood will be overseen through a range of bodies including: Ofgem... LCCC... DESNZ CGL... DESNZ Cluster Function Team"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Introduction of the UK Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism in 2027 placing unabated UK cement sites at a competitive disadvantage against international producers.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Accelerate CCUS deployment at Padeswood to establish low-carbon cement production capability ahead of 2027 CBAM implementation.",
      "evidence": "The UK Carbon-Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)... will be introduced in 2027. However, unabated UK sites would be competing with sites overseas."
    }
  ]
}
